video.title: Is it WORTH it to attend Tech Conferences in 2025? 🤔 #tech #community

transcript.text: I have been to so many tech conferences
now and trust me they're totally worth
it. Let me tell you why. Number one is
you get to meet all the talented people
actually building the tools that you use
every day. Second, in this conferences
you learn from real world stories or
case studies that you cannot find on
YouTube, blogs or anywhere else. The
most important point is you have a
chance to build genuine connections with
founders, CEOs and recruiters that can
help you land your next job. Lastly,
collect all the amazing swags and
goodies from boots at these conferences.
